text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way home, right after finishing
our daily training and parting ways with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>!
The one who called out was Aoi Kiryuin, an earnest fellow Trainer affiliated with Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Good work today.
We're just wrapping up our work as well—

"Looking thoroughly exhausted, Trainer Riko Kashimoto—
a strict yet brilliant peer from Tracen Academy—arrived."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...
Good work... today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer Kashimoto!
You really should still be resting...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not a problem.
It's not as if... *pant*...
I'm particularly tired... or anything.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto!
Good work today. Did you just finish training?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you for your hard work.
Lastly, I was thinking of checking the course
one more time for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
! I was just thinking the exact same thing.
I-If you'd like... well, um...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Shall the two of us go around together?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. If it's a simple check,
that would be more efficient anyway."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Let's make our rounds quickly, then!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's only slight,
but the turf is a bit rough...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The academy should be handling maintenance first thing tomorrow morning,
but if you're doing early morning practice, you ought to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
Um, next is... that way!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...The dirt is... *pant*, well-groomed.
This should, *whew*, be no problem..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto? Are you okay?
C-Could it be that my pace was too fast?!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
Let's try turning a bit more slowly—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No.
...There is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, we could go a little faster.
Let's hurry, Trainer Kiryuin."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
R-Really...!?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
Th-The turf over here is a bit better...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer Kashimoto!
Pushing yourself too hard isn't good~...!

choice_data_list: I see, so that's why you sprinted at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic...
I've shown you such an unsightly side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
N-No! But, um, err.
Ah, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Today's training was magnificent!
And not just in terms of your fast times.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer and the Umamusume were so in sync... You could really tell how much they trusted each other.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that, I have to agree as well.
It was a training session that couldn't be done without a strong bond of trust.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I don't believe we are inferior.
My trainee and I have come this far together, after all."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even if they ran in the same race right now,
our Umamusume would win. That's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "M-Me too! I may have said all that, but I don't think our Bitter Glacé is going to lose either!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The one working hard is Meek, the one running is Meek!
Once the gates open,
all I can do is watch, but still!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That is why, more than anyone else...
I believe in Meek.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer <username>,
what about you? Do you believe in Umamusume?"
choice_data_list: When it comes to the power of belief, I have no intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...That was a foolish question, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I wish you the best of luck, Trainer Kiryuin.
And to you as well, Trainer <username>.

It was a night where, wishing each other the best,
I renewed my resolve to keep believing in <chrname> and do my best...!
